source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Count is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Translate contextual gains, losses, directions, and rates into signed' is answered as count rather than signed value.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Count is what produces signed value, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Translate contextual gains, losses, directions, and.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: signed value is settled by running 'Evaluate integer division by reframing it as a missing-factor': An integer division asks what number multiplied by the divisor gives the dividend; the — on the item about Translate contextual gains, losses, directions, and.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Signed value is computed by squaring count and leaving signed value linear, so the written value is 33 — on the item about Translate contextual gains, losses, directions, and.

intelligence.enrichment: A repeated contextual value is represented as count x signed value, and a total is found by adding the signed contributions to any starting value.
